s: Monetization Strategy Our monetization strategy includes offering an API - AI textual tattoo idea generator, enabling businesses and developers to leverage our technology to enhance their own products and services.
To obtain an AI key for API access, users can choose a pricing plan on our website and initiate contact by using the designated button, submitting their request.
Moreover, our service offers users the capability to generate preliminary tattoo sketches through an AI-driven tattoo design tool.
The Company offers the "AI Powered Tattoo Artist," a subscription-based API service that utilizes artificial intelligence to generate custom tattoo designs.
The "AI Powered Tattoo Artist" API is available through both a free trial plan with limited features and paid subscription plans for different amount of API requests. 2.
